description: 白象插入长斜，切断黑方后象联系
explanation_en: White's bishop interposes on the long diagonal, attacking the queen while cutting off the bishop that defended it. Black cannot save the queen.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：黑后在c6，黑象在b7，都在a8-h1长斜上协同。白象能插入d5，切断它们的联系吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: Black's queen is on c6 and bishop on b7, connected along the a8-h1 diagonal. Can White's bishop interpose on d5 and break their connection?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bd5！象插入d5，直接威胁Qc6同时切断Bb7支援——黑方被迫失后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bd5 attacks the queen on c6 while cutting off its support from the bishop on b7. Black cannot save the queen.

moves.popup: 白象Bd5！插入d5，直接攻击Qc6，同时切断Bb7通过长斜支援黑后的路线！
moves.popup_en: White plays Bd5, attacking the queen on c6 and interrupting the bishop's support along the long diagonal.

moves.popup: 黑方Be7→Bg5——象撤退，但Qc6已无法守护，黑后处境危险。
moves.popup_en: Black retreats the bishop to g5, but it can no longer defend the queen on c6, which is now lost.

moves.popup: 白象Bxc6！吃掉黑后——拦截战术成功，白方大获！
moves.popup_en: White's bishop captures the queen on c6. The interference succeeds, and White wins decisively.
